this_run: Independent local repositories, no remotes; local Git IDs are evidence identities, not retrievable upstream refs.
cleanup: The owned working copies, databases, profiles and tools will be removed after preservation. Old paths and local Git IDs cannot be assumed to remain usable.
next_start: Preparation owner reconstructs a fresh, quality-checked completed application, creates a separate count-only defective fixture, calibrates the common checks, prepares independent byte-matching A/B source+data and supplies a new baseline manifest and references. Start only after those inputs and fixed entries exist and are demonstrated.
stop_on_missing_assets: Stop and return to the preparation owner. Keep the missing artifact name, intended baseline, supplied references and any checks already run. Resume only after a newly identified common baseline and checks are verified for both conditions.
records: Historical conditions and results remain evidence, not an executable delivery package. No new source repository, runtime distribution, or cloud deployment is implied.
